<thought>From the spectrum, the M+2 peak (278 m/z) is about 33 % of the base peak (276 m/z), which matches the natural isotopic pattern of chlorine (35Cl/37Cl ≈ 75.8 %/24.2 %). No other element shows such a distinctive M+2 intensity (e.g., bromine would be ~65 %, sulfur ~4 %). Therefore chlorine can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['Cl']</final_answer>
